prompt: A pricing page with three plans (Free, Pro, Team), their features and a call to action for each.
system:
You are a UI generator. Respond with the body only: one catalog markup root, no prose, markdown or code fences.
Use nested catalog tags with props as quoted attributes. No text nodes; put text in props. Use /> for leaves.
Attribute values are strings. Numbers, booleans and arrays use JSON text, decoded only when accepted by the prop schema.
Use single quotes around JSON attributes; JSON backslashes are kept as-is. Escape the enclosing quote with a backslash, or use " & < > '.
Only the listed props are supported. Omit optional props you do not need. Include realistic sample content.
<Stack gap="lg"><Heading level="h1" text="Revenue"/><Table columns='["Product","Units"]' rows='[["Trail Runner 3",412]]'/></Stack>

AVAILABLE COMPONENTS:
- Stack: { direction?: "vertical" | "horizontal", gap?: "none" | "sm" | "md" | "lg", align?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "stretch" } - Flex layout. Vertical by default; horizontal wraps. [accepts children]
- Grid: { columns?: "1" | "2" | "3" | "4", gap?: "none" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" } - Responsive grid of children. [accepts children]
- Card: { title?: string, description?: string } - Bordered surface with optional title and description; children go in its body. [accepts children]
- Heading: { text: string, level?: "h1" | "h2" | "h3" | "h4" } - Section heading.
- Text: { text: string, variant?: "body" | "lead" | "muted" | "small" } - Paragraph of text.
- Button: { label: string, variant?: "default" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost" | "destructive" | "link", size?: "sm" | "default" | "lg" } - Button.
- Input: { label?: string, placeholder?: string, type?: "text" | "email" | "password" | "number" | "search" | "tel" | "url", value?: string } - Labelled text field.
- Select: { label?: string, placeholder?: string, options: Array<string>, value?: string } - Dropdown of string options.
- Table: { columns: Array<string>, rows: Array<Array<string | number>>, caption?: string } - Data table: column headers and rows of cells.
- List: { items: Array<string>, ordered?: boolean } - Bulleted or numbered list.
- Stat: { label: string, value: string, change?: string, trend?: "up" | "down" | "neutral" } - Single metric with optional change and trend.
- Image: { src: string, alt: string, aspect?: "square" | "video" | "wide" | "auto" } - Image from an http(s) URL.
- Badge: { text: string, variant?: "default" | "secondary" | "outline" | "destructive" } - Small status label.
- Chart: { type: "bar" | "line" | "area" | "pie", data: Array<{ label: string, value: number }>, title?: string } - Single-series bar, line, area or pie chart.
- Tabs: { tabs: Array<string>, value?: string } - Tab strip; switching tabs is local. Child i is the panel for tabs[i]. [accepts children]
- Checkbox: { label: string, checked?: boolean } - Labelled checkbox.
- Switch: { label: string, description?: string, checked?: boolean } - Labelled on/off toggle with optional helper text.
- Textarea: { label?: string, placeholder?: string, value?: string } - Labelled multi-line text field.
- RadioGroup: { label?: string, options: Array<string>, value?: string } - Single choice from string options.
- Progress: { label?: string, value: number } - Progress bar, value 0-100, with optional label.
- Avatar: { name: string, src?: string, size?: "sm" | "default" | "lg" } - Round avatar; shows the name initials when there is no image URL.
- Alert: { title: string, description?: string, variant?: "default" | "destructive" } - Inline notice with a title and optional description; destructive for errors.
- Separator: {  } - Thin horizontal divider.
- Accordion: { items: Array<string> } - Collapsible sections. Child i is the content for items[i]. [accepts children]

DESIGN BRIEF (applies to every UI you produce):
- Build a complete, realistic screen, not a skeleton: a clear title and intro, grouped sections, and enough detail that it could ship.
- Cover exactly what the request names, with no extra pages or marketing sections.
- Use the supplied DATA in full: every field is there to be shown. Derive useful extras from it (shares, totals, deltas, rankings) instead of inventing unrelated numbers.
- Where it fits, add status badges, trend/change figures, secondary actions, helper text, and sensible empty or edge-case copy.
- Establish hierarchy with headings, size and weight; group related items; keep spacing and alignment consistent.
- Make charts readable: a title, labelled axes or values, and a legend for pie charts.
- Never use lorem ipsum or placeholder names like "Item 1".

<Stack gap="lg">
  <Stack gap="sm" align="center">
    <Badge text="Pricing" variant="secondary" />
    <Heading level="h1" text="Simple, transparent pricing" />
    <Text variant="lead" text="Start free, upgrade when your team grows. Every plan includes unlimited projects, 14-day history and core integrations — no credit card required." />
  </Stack>

  <Grid columns="3" gap="lg">
    <Card title="Free" description="For individuals and small side projects getting started with the basics.">
      <Stack gap="md">
        <Stack gap="xs" direction="vertical">
          <Text variant="muted" text="Everything you need to evaluate the product:" />
          <Text variant="h2" text="$0" />
          <Text variant="small" text="forever — no credit card required" />
        </Stack>
        <Separator />
        <Stack gap="sm" direction="vertical">
          <Heading level="h3" text="What’s included" />
          <List items="["1 project workspace","Up to 3 collaborators","7 days of activity history","2 GB file storage","Community support","Basic dashboard analytics"]" />
        </Stack>
        <Button label="Start for free" variant="outline" size="lg" />
        <Text variant="small" text="Free for as long as you like. Upgrade or cancel anytime." />
      </Stack>
    </Card>

    <Card title="Pro" description="For professionals and growing teams who need more power and automation.">
      <Stack gap="md">
        <Stack gap="xs" direction="vertical">
          <Badge text="Most popular" variant="default" />
          <Text variant="muted" text="For professionals who ship every day:" />
          <Text variant="h2" text="$24" />
          <Text variant="small" text="per user / month, billed annually" />
        </Stack>
        <Separator />
        <Stack gap="sm" direction="vertical">
          <Heading level="h3" text="Everything in Free, plus" />
          <List items="["Unlimited projects and workspaces","Unlimited collaborators","365-day activity history","100 GB file storage","Automations and workflows","Advanced analytics and custom reports","API access and webhooks","Priority email support"]" />
        </Stack>
        <Button label="Start 14-day Pro trial" variant="default" size="lg" />
        <Text variant="small" text="No charge for 14 days. Switch to monthly billing at any time." />
      </Stack>
    </Card>

    <Card title="Team" description="For organizations that need scale, security and centralised billing.">
      <Stack gap="md">
        <Stack gap="xs" direction="vertical">
          <Text variant="muted" text="For organizations operating at scale:" />
          <Text variant="h2" text="$49" />
          <Text variant="small" text="per user / month, billed annually — $39 on 20+ seats" />
        </Stack>
        <Separator />
        <Stack gap="sm" direction="vertical">
          <Heading level="h3" text="Everything in Pro, plus" />
          <List items="["Centralised billing and seat management","SSO via SAML and SCIM provisioning","Role-based access controls","1 TB pooled file storage","Shared team dashboards","Audit log and data export","Sandbox environment","Dedicated customer success manager"]" />
        </Stack>
        <Button label="Contact sales" variant="default" size="lg" />
        <Text variant="small" text="Volume discounts available from 50 seats. Onboarding included." />
      </Stack>
    </Card>
  </Grid>

  <Card title="Frequently asked questions">
    <Accordion items="["Can I change plans later?","What counts as a collaborator?","Do you offer discounts for nonprofits or education?","What happens to my data if I downgrade?","Is there a monthly billing option?"]">
      <Text text="Yes. You can upgrade, downgrade or change your billing cycle from workspace settings. Changes take effect at the start of the next billing period, and we prorate upgrades automatically." />
      <Text text="A collaborator is anyone who can view or edit shared content in your workspace. Guests with view-only access and viewers of public links are free on every plan." />
      <Text text="We offer 50% off Pro and Team for registered nonprofits, students and educators. Send us a verification letter from your organisation and we will apply the discount to your account." />
      <Text text="Your data is never deleted when you downgrade. You keep read-only access to everything created on your previous plan, and we hold it for 12 months in case you upgrade again." />
      <Text text="Monthly billing is available on Pro and Team at a 20% premium over the annual price. Team seats above 10 are always billed monthly." />
    </Accordion>
  </Card>

  <Card title="Need a hand choosing?" description="Tell us how many people will use the workspace and we will recommend the right plan — usually within one business day.">
    <Stack gap="md" direction="horizontal" align="end">
      <Input label="Work email" placeholder="you@company.com" type="email" />
      <Input label="Team size" placeholder="25" type="number" />
      <Button label="Get a recommendation" variant="default" />
    </Stack>
    <Text variant="small" text="Prefer email? Write to sales@productname.example and we will reply within one business day." />
  </Card>
</Stack>
